c1193ca5c4a03f26.description: Schpot is a Bangalore marketplace for booking offbeat, aesthetic and functional spaces by the hour. On top of those spaces, we now design and run small, curated experiences for new-age companies that want to meet their teams, users and communities offline. We've already run these for teams like Cursor, Grok, Anthropic, Swish, Stoc, Dezerv, Turing and many more. We have a functional, revenue-generating V1, built fast with AI-native tooling. It works and it's growing. Now we're growing the engineering team to take it from "ships fast" to "ships fast and scales". You'll own big parts of the codebase and help set how we build. You don't take pride in hand-writing every div. You take pride in shipping a polished, secure, scalable product at lightning speed, using the best AI tools available. **Location:** Bengaluru only (in person) · **Type:** Full-time ## What you'll do - **Own your areas.** Take ownership of parts of a live codebase that's been built lean, harden them and make them genuinely yours. - **Ship across the full stack.** Frontend to backend to database. You own features end to end, daily, not weekly. - **Own the hard integrations.** Secure Cashfree payment flows, WhatsApp Business API webhooks (our primary ops channel) and tight Supabase RLS policies. The things AI can't one-shot. - **Deepen what's already live.** Booking flows, availability and calendar sync, host onboarding and payments: extend and level up the systems already running, and build the next layer on top. - **Build for the long term.** Monitoring, observability, alerting and experimentation, so we catch problems early and make product calls on data. - **Run the rails.** Solid CI/CD from GitHub to Vercel, a database that's secure and backed up, and the production discipline a real marketplace needs. - **Shape the roadmap.** Work with the founder and the team on what to build next, and bring your own ideas. ## The stack - **Frontend:** React 18 + TypeScript (Vite and Next.js), Tailwind, shadcn-ui (Radix), TanStack Query v5 - **Backend:** Supabase - **Edge functions:** Deno - **Payments:** Cashfree - **Comms:** WhatsApp Business API (our primary channel; most ops run through WhatsApp, not email) - **Deploy:** Vercel - **Your copilot:** Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, whatever makes you fast. If you're hand-writing boilerplate, you're working too slow. ## Who you are **Must-haves** - **You're based in Bengaluru.** This role is in person, and we're only hiring in Bengaluru. - **You have 3 to 5 years shipping production web apps.** You've put real React in front of real users, and you know when to reach for a useEffect and when not to. - **You have startup experience.** You've worked at an early-stage startup or small team (under ~100 people), worn many hats, and know what productive chaos feels like. - **You're comfortable in Supabase and Postgres.** Row-level security doesn't scare you. You can write a secure Postgres function without a three-day detour. - **You've run production systems.** You've set up monitoring, error tracking or alerting, and you've been the one who fixed it when something broke at 11pm. - **You have full-stack range and product taste.** You move from a DB schema to a UI that feels right, and you notice when the padding is off by 2px. - **You're self-driven and adaptable.** A zero-to-one startup changes shape constantly. That's the fun part for you, and you bring ideas rather than wait for tickets. - **You're AI-native.** You already use AI daily and have a real point of view on where it helps and where it doesn't. - **You balance speed and stability.** You ship in days, not weeks: scrappy where things are cheap to change, careful where they aren't (payments, auth, data). You'd rather release behind a feature flag and iterate than wait for perfect, and you refactor pragmatically instead of rewriting working code. **Bonus points** - You've **built an AI agent**, even a scrappy side project. Especially if it's scrappy. - You've worked on **marketplaces, payments or scheduling/calendar systems**. - You've run **A/B tests or feature flags in production**, or set up product analytics. ## What success looks like - **First week:** Set up locally, shipped your first change to production, and flagged the biggest risks you see in the codebase. - **3 months:** Hardened payments, WhatsApp webhooks and RLS. Put monitoring, error tracking, alerting and observability in place across the app and edge functions, so we hear about problems before users do. Got experimentation running (feature flags, A/B tests) so product calls are backed by data. Helped set engineering standards (code review, testing, incident playbook) so the platform scales without heroics. Shaped the roadmap by bringing your own ideas, not just executing ours. ## Why this one - **Work directly with a founder who's done this before.** 15 years in product, including senior 0-to-1 roles at Google and Adobe, and a previous startup acquired by HP. Tight loops, no telephone game. - **Real ownership.** You're not maintaining someone else's vision deep inside a 200-person org. You'll own real parts of the product, not a ticket queue. - **A modern, lean, type-safe stack** with no legacy baggage, and the freedom to shape what comes next. - **Early in something live,** with paying customers and room to grow with the company. ## How to apply Skip the generic cover letter. Apply here on Wellfound and include: - **Your resume.** - **A portfolio link:** one live app you've built that looks great on mobile. - **The AI question:** briefly, how do you use AI in your workflow today? Bonus if you've shipped an AI agent. - **Availability:** when can you start? We read everything.

Headquarters: Americas Remote

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies, from scrappy startups to global brands, use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

Hi! I’m Lauren, Senior Manager of Customer Success at Customer.io. I’m looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager, Strategic to join our Americas team and own relationships with some of our largest customers. You’ll guide each account from onboarding through renewal, tie platform use to the business results your customers care about, and partner with Account Managers, Technical Support, Product, and Engineering along the way.

What we value

• Customer outcomes first: you connect what a customer does in Customer.io to the goals their business is trying to reach

• Ownership: you run your book of business, watch for risk early, and decide on next steps with confidence

• Collaboration: you work with Account Managers, Technical Support, Product, and Engineering to get customers what they need

• Curiosity about AI: you pick up new AI functionality quickly and bring it into your conversations with customers

• Adaptability: you handle a varied, non-verticalized book and a fast pace of change with a steady head

What you’ll do

• Manage a book of roughly 20 to 35 Strategic customers, each above $100k in ARR, guiding them through onboarding, adoption, and long-term success

• Link platform use to measurable business outcomes, and track results such as renewal rate and growth dollars across your book

• Partner with Account Managers to spot and qualify expansion opportunities, shape renewal strategy, and keep customer value aligned with revenue goals

• Lead quarterly and executive business reviews, including onsite EBRs, and build mutual success plans with senior stakeholders

• Build relationships with several stakeholders in each account, including leaders above the day-to-day decision maker

• Read account risk closely, dig into the signals, and decide on the best next steps, including managing escalations

• Talk through technical needs with users, then raise the conversation to strategic impact with executive sponsors and give recommendations that keep customers renewing year after year

• Act as a bridge between Customer Success, Technical Support, Product, and Engineering, advocating for customers and bringing fresh perspectives to the CS org

What we’re looking for

• Based in the U.S. or Canada, and open to travel

• 5+ years of enterprise CSM experience in SaaS, managing complex, strategic accounts

• Hands-on commercial involvement in renewals, upsell, or expansion, with a clear grasp of gross retention and expansion drivers

• Strategic, consultative skills: you can tie platform usage to business value and present that impact to executives through EBRs and partnership reviews

• Comfort with APIs, integrations, and data models, enough to problem-solve at a high level without handing off every technical question

• Influence across teams, with a track record of getting colleagues to focus on customer needs

• Enthusiasm for AI and the urgency to keep learning new functionality as it ships

Bonus points!

• Background in martech, CDPs, or messaging platforms

• Spanish language skills

• Experience running client onsites

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $130,000 base + 10% variable (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.  In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

Here's what you can expect from our hiring process:

• 

30-minute video call with a Recruiter

• 

45-minute video call with the Hiring Manager

• 

60-minute Case Study Review with the Hiring Manager and potential team members

• 

Final 30-minute video call with Leadership

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io.

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you’re excited by what you read, apply now.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-senior-customer-success-manager-strategic

As Fin becomes mission-critical for our most strategic customers, we’re growing our team of Forward Deployed Engineers to help bridge the gap between customer needs and product innovation. 

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work hands-on with strategic customers, partnering closely with our R&D and Go-to-Market teams to design and deliver high-impact solutions. What skills do I need?

• The ability to prototype and ship software quickly while maintaining a high bar for quality and a clear focus on business goals and outcomes.

• Proficiency using and writing REST APIs to integrate systems effectively.

• Strong communication skills. You can comfortably discuss the same topics with engineers and non-technical audiences, adapting the depth and detail as needed.

• Willingness to travel and work on-site with customers to build strong relationships and deeply understand their needs.

Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). 

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Policies 

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.

It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. …

We are seeking a hands-on, systems-driven RevOps Manager to own the data, tools, and processes behind every stage of our revenue funnel: signup, trial, paid, renewal, expansion, and churn. ClickGuard will run four motions on the same stack: a self-serve trial, a sales-assisted motion for larger advertisers, outbound to advertisers and PPC agencies, and an agency partner program. This role makes sure a trial, a paying customer, and a dollar of MRR are counted the same way in HubSpot, Stripe, PostHog, and every report built on them. This is an AI-first operations role for someone who has personally built revenue systems that leadership used to run the business, and who uses AI to do the work of a larger ops team. You will own our CRM, our funnel data, the weekly revenue scorecard, and the workflows that move accounts from one stage to the next.

Your superpower is turning messy, disconnected data into numbers people act on. You treat RevOps as a data and systems problem first, and an admin problem second. Every workflow you build has an owner, a test, and an alert when it breaks, so a broken lead flow shows up in your inbox the same day it breaks and gets fixed before it reaches the quarter-end numbers.

Using AI tools is the baseline. We want someone who can show what they have personally built with AI, how it changed their workflow or capacity, and what measurable impact it had on data quality, speed, conversion, revenue, or headcount efficiency.

What You'll Own

• HubSpot end-to-end: object model (contacts, companies, workspaces, deals, tickets), lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, workflows, and permissions, with one owner per field and every critical workflow tested and monitored

• The revenue data layer (built with our engineering and data team): the app, Stripe, and HubSpot feeding PostHog, with shared definitions for trial, paid, MRR, churn, expansion, and reactivation that every report uses

• Funnel instrumentation and attribution: source captured at signup, account qualification by measured ad spend, and a clear trail from first touch to trial to paid to renewal

• AI-powered RevOps systems at scale: build and operate workflows where AI materially increases throughput across enrichment, routing, lead and account scoring, health scoring, data hygiene, and reporting. You should be able to demonstrate systems you have personally built and the business results they produced.

• 

The weekly revenue scorecard for the leadership meeting, pulled from source data; and the operating processes behind sales and customer success: quote and discount approvals, agency account handovers, refunds, chargebacks, and failed-payment recovery.

You're a Fit If

• You've personally rebuilt a CRM that a revenue team relied on, and you can show the before and after: workflows fixed, fields retired, duplicate records merged, and reports leadership started to trust.

• You have built real AI-powered workflows and can show what you built, where AI sat in the workflow, what it automated or augmented, and the measurable impact it created.

• You understand subscription revenue well enough to reconcile MRR between Stripe and the CRM, and to explain why the two numbers differ

• Hands-on with HubSpot (Operations Hub or equivalent), SQL, CLI, API’s, Webhooks, n8n/Make, and Claude Code or Codex

• You can explain lifecycle stages, deal pipelines, and attribution models without Googling

• You treat product usage as revenue data: trial activity, connected ad accounts, and plan limits feed scoring and routing

You're Not a Fit If

• Your experience is mostly building dashboards on top of data someone else had to fix

• You measure success in workflows built and tickets closed rather than conversion and revenue

• You need a team around you; this role is the builder for our foundation

Required Skills & Experience

• 3-5+ Years in RevOps or Revenue Systems: Proven experience owning the CRM and revenue data for a B2B SaaS company, ideally one with a self-serve trial or product-led motion. You can show the numbers: data completeness, workflow reliability, funnel conversion, forecast accuracy, and time saved.

• CRM Architecture: Concrete experience designing an object model, lifecycle stages, and pipelines from scratch, or rebuilding a broken one, including migrations that keep the history intact. You document every field you create and retire the ones nobody uses.

• Data Ownership: You have personally owned the path from source system to report: event tracking, warehouse tables, SQL, and reconciliation against billing. When two systems disagree, you find out why before anyone reports the number.

• AI-Native Execution: You have personally built AI-powered systems inside a revenue workflow, including enrichment, scoring, routing, classification, data cleanup, forecasting, or agentic workflows. You can clearly explain what you built, why you built it, how it worked, and what measurable result it produced in terms of pipeline, revenue, productivity, speed, quality, or reduced manual work.

• Full-Funnel Accountability: You measure your work through the full chain from signup → trial → qualified account → paid → renewal → expansion. You can show examples where a process you built moved conversion or retention. You are comfortable killing your own workflows when the data says they are not helping.

• Cross-Team Range: Ability to work with sales, customer success, marketing, finance, and engineering: you write specs an engineer can build from and processes a sales rep will follow.

Technical Proficiency

• HubSpot CRM Ecosystem: (Expert Level) Custom objects, associations, workflows, lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, lists, permissions, and the HubSpot API.

• SQL & Product Analytics: (Working Level) Comfortable writing SQL against a warehouse (PostHog or equivalent) and joining product events with billing and CRM data.

• Billing Systems: Working fluency with Stripe: subscriptions, invoices, coupons, failed payments, and how each one shows up in MRR.

• Enrichment & Data APIs: Clay or equivalent, people and company data providers, and comfort consuming REST APIs and webhooks directly.

• Automation Engineering: Strong execution knowledge of workflow automation (n8n, Make, or native AI-agent integrations) and AI coding tools (Claude Code or Codex), connecting the stack without engineering support.

Logistics

• Remote, async-first team culture.

• Must have overlapping availability for live syncs between 7 AM and 2 PM EST.

• Full-time, long-term position.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/clickguard-inc-revops-manager
